mapper.subject: Your {{brand_display_name}} Charter is Confirmed!
mapper.body:
Hi {{client_first_name}},

Your charter is officially confirmed — we cannot wait to create an unforgettable experience for you!

Your Booking Details:

  • Date: {{charter_date_formatted}}
  • Vessel: {{ifempty(1.fields.Yacht Name; "—")}}
  • Guests: {{ifempty(1.fields.Guest Count; "—")}}
  • Occasion: {{ifempty(1.fields.Occasion; "—")}}
  • Boarding Location: {{ifempty(1.fields.Boarding Location; "—")}}

Your dedicated concierge will be in touch within 48 hours with everything you need to know before your charter day.

In the meantime, please don't hesitate to reply to this email with any questions.

We'll see you on the water!

Warmly,
The {{brand_display_name}} Team

metadata.notes: === MANUAL ACTION REQUIRED === After import: (1) Rebind Airtable connection on modules 1, 6, 10 to SSS PAT. Module 1: Bookings (tbl72omPibBkn2hZL). Module 6: Clients (tblr84vRIWC5HmKvo). Module 10: Bookings (tbl72omPibBkn2hZL). (2) Rebind Gmail OAuth on module 8 to hello@shesaidsail.com. (3) Replace PASTE_QUO_SMS_API_KEY_HERE in module 9. (4) Replace PASTE_OPS_LOGGER_ALERTER_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE in module 11. === SAFETY CHAIN — ALL FOUR MUST PASS === Gate 2: Automations_Paused = false. Gate 3: Emergency_Flag = false. Gate 4: Concierge_Assigned = true (concierge MUST be assigned before confirmation). Gate 5: Confirmation_Sent = false (idempotency — prevents duplicate sends). If ANY gate fails, scenario stops silently. Check all four before debugging. === AIRTABLE PRE-WORK === Clients table (tblr84vRIWC5HmKvo) must exist with fields: Name, Email, Phone. Bookings table must have Client field (linked record to Clients). If Clients table is unavailable, module 7 fallback uses Client Email / Client Name / Client Phone fields directly from Bookings. TRIGGER: Bookings, Status = CONFIRMED, Confirmation_Sent = 0, Environment = Production. Polls every 15 minutes. WRITES: Confirmation_Sent = true, D0 Sent = true.
